correctness.rationale: The enclosing event has probability 1/4, and the conditional half-contact-gap simplex a+b+c=L=pi/2 is uniform with density 2/L^2. The exact incircle area is S=cot a+cot b+cot c. The union B_t of one-coordinate strips a<arccot t has area 3Lr-9r^2/2. Decomposing E_t\B_t into three middle edges and three double-small-coordinate corners with eta=t^(-1/3), the middle strips give 6log(cot eta)/t^2 and the scaled corner integral J_T=1+2log(T-1) yields 3[1+2log(t eta-1)]/t^2. The artificial cutoff cancels; the unnormalized area is 3L/t+(6log t-3/2)/t^2+o(t^-2). After multiplying 2/L^2 this is 12/(pi t)+(48log t-12)/(pi^2 t^2)+o(t^-2). Independent one-dimensional numerical quadrature at t=100,250,500,1000,2500,5000 exhibits decaying t^2-scaled residual (absolute values ~0.006 to ~0.00025), corroborating but not proving the asymptotic. Circumcircle radius is fixed to 1 and conditioning explicit.
